title: Relational Databases — Beginner
description: Learn the fundamentals of relational databases and core SQL.

sections.title: Database Fundamentals
sections.description: Understand what relational databases are and why they matter.
learning_objectives: Explain what a relational database is
Compare relational and non-relational storage at a high level

sections.title: Relational Modeling Basics
sections.description: Model data using related tables and keys.

sections.title: SQL Fundamentals
sections.description: Write basic SQL statements to query data.
learning_objectives: Write SELECT statements with filtering and sorting
Perform INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations

sections.title: Joins
sections.description: Combine data from multiple related tables.

sections.title: Aggregations
sections.description: Summarize data using aggregate functions and grouping.

sections.title: Constraints
sections.description: Enforce data integrity using database constraints.
learning_objectives: Apply primary key and foreign key constraints

title: Relational Databases — Intermediate
description: Design normalized schemas and work with transactions.

sections.title: Normalization
sections.description: Organize schemas to reduce redundancy and anomalies.
learning_objectives: Balance normalization with practical design needs

sections.title: Schema Design
sections.description: Design relational schemas for real-world applications.

sections.title: Advanced SQL Queries
sections.description: Write more complex SQL using subqueries and set operations.
learning_objectives: Apply window functions at a basic level

sections.title: Transactions
sections.description: Group operations into atomic units of work.
learning_objectives: Identify operations that must be transactional

sections.title: ACID Properties
sections.description: Understand the guarantees relational databases provide.
learning_objectives: Explain atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability
Relate ACID properties to real failure scenarios
Reason about isolation levels at a conceptual level

sections.title: Indexes
sections.description: Use indexes to improve query performance.
learning_objectives: Explain how indexes speed up queries
Understand the write-cost trade-off of indexes

title: Relational Databases — Advanced
description: Optimize queries and design databases for concurrency and production scale.

sections.title: Query Optimization
learning_objectives: Identify and fix slow query patterns
Apply indexing strategy to optimize queries

sections.title: Concurrency Control
sections.description: Manage simultaneous access to data safely.
learning_objectives: Explain locking and isolation levels in depth

sections.title: Advanced Transaction Design
sections.description: Apply advanced transactional patterns in application design.
learning_objectives: Apply optimistic vs pessimistic concurrency strategies

sections.title: Advanced Schema Design
sections.description: Design schemas for large, evolving production systems.

sections.title: Production Indexing Strategy
sections.description: Apply advanced indexing strategies in production databases.
learning_objectives: Balance index count against write performance

sections.title: Production Database Considerations
sections.description: Address the realities of operating databases in production.
learning_objectives: Reason about replication and consistency trade-offs
Plan capacity for a growing dataset
